_comment: Staging fragment for ONE car-seat stroller ADAPTER (deduped by SKU — many strollers share one adapter). Copy to <adapter-id>.json (filename MUST equal the id in _ROSTER.md / the seed.json 'adapter' module), fill EVERY field, commit ONLY this file + its image. Do NOT edit seed.json. Every adapter here connects the Clek Liing/Liingo to one or more strollers on _CLEK_LIST.md. See ../../CLEK_COMPAT_RESEARCH_PLAN.md.
name: Adapter product name as sold (e.g. 'Bugaboo Butterfly car seat adapter')
partNumber: Manufacturer part # from Clek's list (e.g. 100045001) — or null if none listed
madeBy: Who manufactures it: the stroller brand (e.g. Bugaboo) OR Clek (CRUZ/Vista only)
seatBrandsSupported: Which infant-seat footprints it fits, per the product page (e.g. 'Maxi-Cosi / Cybex / Nuna / Clek'). Confirm Clek Liing is explicitly supported.

status._comment: Clek flags several adapters discontinued. Record real availability.
status.clekNote: e.g. '**Adapter discontinued' if Clek's list says so, else ''

install._comment: Optional, if published: how it attaches.
install.notes: click-in / strap / mounting-bracket; handle-position or max-weight caveat Clek noted

notes: If Clek's list marks it discontinued, note the current replacement SKU or 'no longer sold'. If bundled/included free with the stroller, say so. If one part # covers single mode and a second is needed for double mode, capture both.
